QUOTE: Every handler's write goes through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, which is the one place that calls `database.write(writer => writer.batch(...))`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says handler writes go through `batchRecords`, but it never gives the reason the item requires (each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`). It also lists two paths that bypass `batchRecords`, which contradicts "every".
